title: Star-Noise Interpreter
text: Star-Noise Interpreter translates reactor static into commands and broadcasts them through every open receiver. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The Engine has been wrong for so long that error sounds sacred.

defeatReward.text: Star-Noise Interpreter is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
